$description: Project backlog — source of truth for the Backlog page of the documentation site. status: proposal | todo | in-progress | done | rejected. origin: decided (Design System Lead) | proposal (Claude).

items.title: Project setup, context file, steps log, workflow
items.description: Design → Guidelines → Code → Prototype.

items.title: Local documentation site and prototypes area
Colors: primitive palettes, semantic roles, contrast check
items.description: 8 palettes, 43 roles, WCAG 2.2 AA check.

items.title: Typography: families, weights, sizes, line heights, text styles
Spacing, radius, border widths, primitive shadows, motion
items.description: Motion respects reduced motion.

items.title: Semantic shadows by usage
items.description: Usages to define (decided "later", step 33).

items.title: Dark mode
items.description: Planned for later (step 8).

items.title: Icons
items.description: Choose an icon set, sizes and naming.

items.title: Breakpoints
items.description: Screen widths for responsive layouts. Used on the documentation site: the site switches to the mobile navigation below 860px (site-only value).

items.title: Layout grid
items.description: Columns 4 / 8 / 12 (mobile / tablet / desktop), gutter 16px, margin 24px, max content width 1040px (margins included). Tokens grid.* and size.content; classes .ds-grid and .ds-grid-span-<n>.

items.title: Z-index
items.description: Stacking order (dropdown, modal, tooltip…). Used on the documentation site: header, mobile navigation and skip link stacking (site-only values). The Timeline panel uses a raw z-index (100) until z-index tokens exist.

items.title: Opacity for disabled elements
items.description: If not covered by the disabled color roles.

items.title: Pill radius
items.description: radius.full (50%) gives an ellipse on rectangles: decide if pill buttons/tags are needed.

items.title: Button
items.description: Uses almost every token category; needed everywhere.

items.title: Icon button
items.description: Variant of the button for icon-only actions. Used on the documentation site: header shortcuts and mobile menu button. Needed by the Timeline small-screen panel: open button (icon timeline) and close button (icon close).

items.title: Link
items.description: Text action, uses text.link. Used on the documentation site: links in texts and descriptions.

items.title: Text input
items.description: Base of every form. Used on the documentation site: Content field of the Design preview tab, icon name field of the Icons page.

items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line input.

items.title: Select
items.description: Choice in a list. Used on the documentation site: status and stage menus of the Backlog page, token menus of the Design preview tab.

items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Multiple choice.

items.title: Radio
items.description: Single choice.

items.title: Switch
items.description: On / off setting.

items.title: Badge
items.description: Small indicator (number or status). First use: the counter of the Navigation item. A Tag (category, filter) would be a separate component, later.

items.title: Alert
items.description: Feedback messages (success, warning, error, info).

items.title: Card
items.description: Content container, uses shadows. Used on the documentation site: home page links and backlog cards.

items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short contextual help.

items.title: Modal
items.description: Dialog, uses the highest shadow.

items.title: Tabs
items.description: Navigation within a page. Used on the documentation site: tabs of the component pages (Design preview, Design spec, Guidelines, Examples, Code).

items.title: First interactive mockup
items.description: Once a few components are coded (e.g. a form or a product page). Screens and content to define with the Design System Lead.

items.title: Version control (git)
items.description: Keep the history of every change and be able to go back.

items.title: Split the tokens page by category
items.description: One documentation page per category (colors, typography, spacing…).

items.title: Show state layers live in the docs
Guidelines for tokens
items.description: When to use each semantic color, text style, spacing.

items.title: Skill: component-spec
items.description: How to write a component design spec (stage 1): sections, level of detail, which tokens to reference, what to ask the Design System Lead.

items.title: Skill: component-guidelines
items.description: How to write component guidelines (stage 2): the 7 sections, tone, do/don't examples.

items.title: Skill: component-code
items.description: Coding rules for components (stage 3): React + TypeScript structure, semantic tokens only, ds- classes, state layers, props naming, examples file.

items.title: Skill: accessibility-check
items.description: WCAG 2.2 AA review of a component or prototype: contrast, keyboard, focus, screen reader, touch targets, reduced motion.

items.title: Skill: prototype-setup
items.description: Sets up a new prototype so it runs with the real React components (backlog item, folder from the template, title, imports, check). The screens are then built with the other skills.

items.title: Skill: token-usage
items.description: Which semantic token to pick for each need (text, background, border, spacing, text style…), with examples.

items.title: Skill: steps-log
items.description: How to write a STEPS.md entry: format, decisions vs actions, files changed.

items.title: Skill: backlog-management
items.description: How to keep backlog/backlog.json up to date: statuses, stages, adding proposals, never starting a proposal.

items.title: Side navigation
items.description: Define the side navigation as a design system component (4 stages). Starting point: the documentation site navigation (brand background, icons, sections, current page in cream).

items.title: Skill: component (main)
items.description: Entry point for every component: routes to the stage sub-skills and enforces the approval gate.

items.title: Skill: component-structure
items.description: Atomic Design: 5 levels, classification, level recorded in meta.json.

items.title: Classify the backlog components by Atomic Design level
items.description: Propose a level (atom, molecule, organism…) for each component in the backlog, for approval.

items.title: Templates and pages vs prototypes
items.description: Decided: prototypes = user journeys built with components; templates and pages are independent layout references, with stages Design → Code → Prototype (no guidelines).

items.title: Show do's and don'ts visually in the Guidelines tab
items.description: Render the do / don't examples of guidelines.md in the documentation site, using the component design preview.

items.title: Navigation item
items.description: A link in a navigation, with an icon and a label (molecule). Used by the Side navigation; done first.

items.title: Skill: layout
items.description: Page margin 24px, vertical spacing between blocks 16px, on the whole documentation site.

items.title: Skill: page-header
items.description: Page title heading-1 (30 characters) and subtitle lead (80 characters), one line each, ellipsis as a safety net.

items.title: Timeline step
items.description: Building block of the Timeline (molecule): one step with its marker and its content. Done first.

items.title: Timeline
items.description: A vertical sequence of steps or events, in chronological order (organism). Built after the Timeline step.

items.title: Header
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Top bar of the site: brand name and logo, search field, work-time clock, shortcuts.

items.title: Search field
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Search of the site header: input with a search icon, keyboard hint "/", list of results.

items.title: Dropdown list (listbox)
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. List of results under the site search, with the active option highlighted.

items.title: Filter chips
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Toggle buttons to filter the backlog by category, and to choose the variant in the Design preview tab.

items.title: Tag
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Small labels: Atomic Design level, backlog category and "Decided" tags. Different from the Badge (counter).

items.title: Stage indicator
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Progress of a component through its stages (Design, Guidelines, Code) and the Complete badge.

items.title: Data table
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Token tables, contrast tables and the tables of specs and guidelines.

items.title: Code block
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Code of the Code tab and of the Icons page, with a Copy button.

items.title: Message banner
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Information note of the Design preview tab and save error of the Backlog page. (The "Alert" proposal was rejected earlier: to decide again.)

items.title: Kanban board
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Backlog columns (Proposals, To do, In progress, Done) with cards.

items.title: Empty state
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Short messages when there is nothing to show ("No components yet", "Not coded yet").

items.title: Skip link
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. "Skip to content" link, visible on keyboard focus.

items.title: Code font (monospace)
items.description: On the documentation site, not defined in the design system yet. Font of token names and code: no design token yet (site-only variable --doc-mono).

items.title: Skill: page-content
items.description: Rules of a page combining a Timeline and Cards: link, order, placement, scrolling and selection.

items.title: Page content: open questions
items.description: Decided: the visible card is the card at the top of the screen; on small screens the timeline is in a burger panel.

items.title: Timeline: small-screen panel
items.description: Update the Timeline (spec, guidelines, code) for screens below desktop: icon-only button (icon timeline) above the cards, panel sliding in from the right with a dimmed background, closes after a step is chosen, close icon button (icon close), Escape or click outside to close. Needs the Icon button. To define: close button position, panel width, shadow, dimmed background color, focus management.

items.title: Skill: token-usage
items.description: Which semantic token to use for which need, in specs and component code. Referenced by the former component skill, not created yet.

items.title: Skill: accessibility-check
items.description: Accessibility check (WCAG 2.2 AA) to run before asking for the approval of any component stage: contrast pairs, target sizes, visible focus.

items.title: Skill: steps-log
items.description: How to log every step in STEPS.md (date, what was done and why, files).

items.title: Skill: backlog-management
items.description: How to keep backlog/backlog.json up to date: statuses, origin, component stage, new proposals.

items.title: Documentation page: How to use skills
items.description: Page of the documentation site (#/skills) read from .claude/skills/: how to use the skills, hierarchy and dispatch table of the orchestrator, one card per skill with its full content.
